name: wa-campaign-manager
description: Chrome extension + optional backend for consent-based personalised WhatsApp campaigns.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix extension ci && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix extension test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix extension run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.e2e: npm --prefix extension run e2e && npm --prefix extension run e2e:cloud
